xna-type.name: StorageContainer
xna-type.summary: Represents a logical collection of storage files.

property.name: DisplayName
property.summary: Gets the name of the title.
property.remarks: This is the same as the displayName passed to BeginOpenContainer .

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates whether the object is disposed.

property.name: Path
property.summary: Gets the file path to the location of the user's save game files.

property.name: StorageDevice
property.summary: Gets the StorageDevice that holds the files in this container.

property.name: TitleLocation
property.summary: Gets the file path to the location of the title storage space.
property.remarks: Use this member to create full paths to files in the same location as the game executable. For example: private static FileStream OpenTitleFile( string filename, FileMode mode, FileAccess access ) { string fullpath = Path.Combine( StorageContainer.TitleLocation, filename ); return File.Open( fullpath, mode, access ); }

property.name: TitleName
property.summary: Gets the name of the title.
property.remarks: This is the same as the titleName passed to OpenContainer .

method.name: CreateDirectory
method.summary: Creates a new directory in the StorageContainer scope.

overload.summary: Creates a new directory in the StorageContainer scope.

parameters.parameter: Type: String The relative path of the directory to delete within the StorageContainer scope.

method.name: CreateFile
method.summary: Creates a file at a specified path in the StorageContainer.

overload.summary: Creates a file at a specified path in the StorageContainer.

parameters.parameter: Type: String The relative path of the file to be created in the StorageContainer .

overload.returns: A new file with read/write access.

method.name: DeleteDirectory
method.summary: Deletes a directory in the StorageContainer scope.

overload.summary: Deletes a directory in the StorageContainer scope.

parameters.parameter: Type: String The relative path of the directory to delete within the StorageContainer scope.

method.name: DeleteFile
method.summary: Deletes a file in the StorageContainer.

overload.summary: Deletes a file in the StorageContainer.

parameters.parameter: Type: String The relative path of the file to delete within the StorageContainer .

method.name: DirectoryExists
method.summary: Determines whether the specified path refers to an existing directory in the StorageContainer.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified path refers to an existing directory in the StorageContainer.

parameters.parameter: Type: String The path to test.

overload.returns: true if path refers to an existing directory in the StorageContainer and is not null; otherwise, false.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.
overload.remarks: After the StorageContainer has been opened on a StorageDevice , changes to the files within the container are cached until the container is disposed. If the storage device is removed or the Xbox 360 is powered down before the container is disposed, any changes are lost.

method.name: FileExists
method.summary: Determines whether the specified path refers to an existing file in the StorageContainer.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified path refers to an existing file in the StorageContainer.

parameters.parameter: Type: String The path and file name to test.

overload.returns: true if path refers to an existing file in the StorageContainer and is not null; otherwise, false.

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Allows this object to attempt to free resources and perform other cleanup operations before garbage collection reclaims the object.

overload.summary: Allows this object to attempt to free resources and perform other cleanup operations before garbage collection reclaims the object.
overload.remarks: This method overrides System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. An object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method disables finalization by the garbage collector.

method.name: GetDirectoryNames
method.summary: Enumerates the directories in the root of a StorageContainer.

overload.summary: Enumerates the directories in the root of a StorageContainer.
overload.returns: An array of relative paths of directories in the root of the StorageContainer. A zero-length array specifies that there are no directories in the root.

overload.summary: Enumerates the directories in the root of a StorageContainer that conform to a search pattern.

parameters.parameter: Type: String A search pattern. Both single-character ("?") and multicharacter ("*") wildcards are supported.

overload.returns: An array of relative paths of directories in the root of the StorageContainer. A zero-length array specifies that there are no directories in the root.

method.name: GetFileNames
method.summary: Enumerates files in the root directory of a StorageContainer that match a given pattern.

overload.summary: Enumerates files in the root directory of a StorageContainer that match a given pattern.

parameters.parameter: Type: String A search pattern. Both single-character ("?") and multicharacter ("*") wildcards are supported.

overload.returns: An array of relative paths of files in the the root directory of StorageContainer scope that match searchPattern. A zero-length array specifies that there are no files that match.
overload.remarks: GetFileNames applies only to the root directory of the StorageContainer . It does not examine any subdirectories.

overload.summary: Enumerates files in the root directory of a StorageContainer.
overload.returns: An array of relative paths of files in the root directory of StorageContainer scope. A zero-length array specifies that there are no files.
overload.remarks: GetFileNames applies only to the root directory of the StorageContainer . It does not examine any subdirectories.

method.name: OpenFile
method.summary: Opens a file in the StorageContainer in the designated mode with the specified read/write access.

overload.summary: Opens a file in the StorageContainer in the designated mode with the specified read/write access.

parameters.parameter: Type: String Relative path of the file within the StorageContainer .
Type: FileMode One of the enumeration values that specifies how to open the file.
Type: FileAccess One of the enumeration values that specifies whether the file is opened with read, write, or read/write access.

overload.returns: An unshared file opened in the designated mode with the specified access.

overload.summary: Opens a file in the StorageContainer.

parameters.parameter: Type: String Relative path of the file within the StorageContainer .
Type: FileMode One of the enumeration values that specifies how to open the file.

overload.returns: An unshared file with read/write access that is opened in the specified mode.

overload.summary: Opens a file in the StorageContainer in the designated mode with the specified read/write access and sharing permission.

parameters.parameter: Type: String Relative path of the file within the StorageContainer .
Type: FileMode One of the enumeration values that specifies how to open the file.
Type: FileAccess One of the enumeration values that specifies whether the file is opened with read, write, or read/write access.
Type: FileShare A bitwise combination of enumeration values that specify the type of access other Stream objects have to this file.

overload.returns: A file opened in the designated mode with the specified access and sharing options.

event.name: Disposing
event.summary: Occurs when Dispose is called or when this object is finalized and collected by the garbage collector of the Microsoft .NET common language runtime.
